content:
alex: Quick heads-up — PR #20567 ready for final review but mac-e2e is flaky in CI, failing `BrowserAuthFlow.test` intermittently.
mira: Can you paste the failing snippet? which test run? last green on main?
alex: failing log below:
```
FAIL BrowserAuthFlow.test (timeout after 5m)
Stack: TimeoutError: waitForSelector timed out
```
alex: last green was on main 2 days ago. this branch rebased yesterday. deploy blackout starts Sat 00:00 UTC — need to decide: try rerun now + manual canary, or hold until Monday and schedule rebase window.
sam: I can trigger a rerun and watch logs. ping me when you're around, I'll re-run the mac matrix.
sam: /ci rerun pr 20567 --matrix=mac-e2e
devops-bot: CI rerun queued: PR 20567, run 8872, mac-e2e started
jordan: If rerun fails twice, I vote hold. We can't risk a partial deploy during blackout. Could we do a targeted canary once mac passes?
mira: I'm happy to approve if only mac-e2e is flaky and smoke + canary pass. @lee can you do a quick canary + rollback plan?
lee: Yep I can kick off a canary on staging and monitor 30m. If green, I'll approve and coordinate the merge timeline.
alex: thanks — will post back after sam's run. marking this thread for eyes: @mira @lee @jordan
sam: rerun finished: mac-e2e PASSED on run 8872 :tada:
alex: great. mira — can you give final review? if approved, lee will do canary and we aim to land before blackout window opens.
mira: Reviewing now, quick nits addressed. Approving.
lee: Starting canary now. will update in thread in 20m.
devops-bot: Canary deployment started: canary-20567 -> staging-canary-3
lee: Canary looks clean (no errors in 25m). rollback tested. thumbs up to merge before blackout.
alex: merging now — thanks everyone. :shipit:
devops-bot: Merge complete: PR 20567 merged to main by alex (commit abc123).
